question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Luxuriant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lush**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Luxuriant"** refers to something rich, abundant, and characterized by profuse growth or production. (समृद्ध, घना)

 
 
• **Example:** The luxuriant forest was filled with tall trees and vibrant greenery.
 
 
 
• **"Lush"** means rich vegetation, abundant and healthy growth, often associated with beauty and vitality. (हराभरा, समृद्ध)
 
 
• **Example:** The garden was lush with colorful flowers and greenery.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Lush" is the most appropriate synonym for "Luxuriant."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Lush**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Barren** (अनउपजाऊ): Refers to land or areas that are unproductive or unable to support vegetation.

 
 
• **Example:** The barren desert stretched as far as the eye could see.
 
 
 
• **Leafless** (पत्तियों से रहित): Refers to trees or plants that have lost their leaves, often due to seasonal changes or damage.
 
 
• **Example:** The leafless branches of the tree swayed in the winter wind.
 
 
 
• **Bleak** (उदासीन, निराशाजनक): Refers to an area lacking vegetation or hope, often cold, desolate, or uninviting.
 
 
• **Example:** The landscape appeared bleak after the storm had passed.
